captions.detailed: A 3D-printable six-sided die featuring rounded corners and edges for smooth rolling. Each face displays standard pip patterns (one through six) represented by spherical indentations. The overall shape is a cube with heavily chamfered/filleted edges, giving it a soft, ergonomic feel.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric loaded die in OpenSCAD where the user can specify which number face (1-6) should be loaded. The script should generate a rounded cube with spherical pip indentations on all six faces, and carve out a hidden internal cavity near the selected face to make it lighter and bias the roll.
captions.factory: The die body is created using a minkowski sum of a cube and a sphere to achieve rounded edges. The pips are defined by sub-modules (One through Six) consisting of translated spheres. These pip modules, along with an offset internal cube representing the hollow loading cavity, are subtracted from the main rounded die body using a difference operation, with the cavity rotated to align with the chosen 'Number' face.
